title: cracca polysperma
intro: Cracca polysperma, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a flowering plant in the pea family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cracca polysperma include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, as well as its use as a diuretic to aid in the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of Cracca polysperma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
